title: Neighbourhood of five platforms held by lines

provenance.basis: Illustrative archetype for projects/floating-city-design-challenge (scenario SCN_FLOATCITY_COASTAL_01); not an engineering design. Design B: five 40 m platforms (three-storey homes, draft from design_A.mid), gaps, hinged walkways, flexible utility links. Moorings are conceptual: piles, or mooring lines with a drawn sag and anchors that are not sized.
